mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a sweltering seventy-four degrees at Harriet Park tonight, feeling more like seventy-eight. Yes, a sticky night under a dark new moon, and sorry space fans, there are no space station sightings tonight. In city news, local students in grades K through twelve have until July twenty-second to submit designs for the next I Voted sticker. In police news, a motorcyclist without a license plate fled an officer at high speed, blowing through red lights. Culvers is closed right now, but they open tomorrow at ten a.m. with their Snickers Swirl flavor of the day.
